cohort: 200 primiparous mothers who visited a primary health center in Hyderabad, India for their child's immunization during the first 6 months postpartum, with healthy babies and no comorbidities
finding: Primiparous mothers who delivered via cesarean section experienced higher levels of perceived psychological stress during the postpartum period compared to those who delivered vaginally.
mod_finding: Moderate stress levels were higher among mothers who delivered via cesarean section.
